On-chip Quantum Measurement of Squeezing Generated from a Silicon Nitride Micro-ring Resonator
item.description: arXiv:2608.03402v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Integration of quantum optical technique on-chip is crucial for large scale applications of quantum technology, which were proven in a free space environment to be superior to the corresponding classical technology. Squeezed states of light can be used for enhancing the sensitivity of quantum sensors and for fault-tolerant quantum computing. Although chip-based squeezed light generation has advanced significantly, practical impact remains limited

item.title: 英特尔代工获微软下一代AI芯片订单，将采用18A工艺
item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。
